head_coach.name: Sabri Lamouchi
head_coach.play_style_summary: Under Lamouchi, the team emphasizes defensive compactness, utilizing a structured mid-to-deep block that transitions rapidly into vertical and direct counter-attacks using high pressing in the middle of the pitch.

key_players.name: Hannibal Mejbri
key_players.performance_stats: Emerged as a primary creative force, logging 25 appearances for Burnley FC in the English Premier League as an essential playmaker.

key_players.name: Montassar Talbi
key_players.performance_stats: Plays as the rock of the defense for FC Lorient, featuring in over 60 caps and serving as the primary defensive leader with strong aerial qualities.

key_players.name: Ellyes Skhiri
key_players.performance_stats: Serves as the experienced team captain, operating as a vital ball-winner and defensive screen for Bundesliga side Eintracht Frankfurt.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Officially announced his retirement from international duty in March 2026.
Excluded from the squad by head coach Sabri Lamouchi as part of a squad rejuvenation and transition strategy.
